distribution.summary: Hebei; Henan; Shaanxi; Yunnan; Anhui; Gansu; Guizhou; Hubei; Jiangsu; Liaoning; Sichuan; Shandong; Shanxi
distribution.narrative: Huang & Lu (2015) reported Hebei, Henan, Shaanxi, Yunnan. These are literature-based records; Mainland China remains Candidate pending occurrence review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Anhui, Gansu, Guizhou, Hubei, Jiangsu, Liaoning, Sichuan, Shandong, Shanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.
